text: 1、市场早间低开低走，三大指数集体下挫。煤炭板块逆势大涨，宝泰隆、陕西黑猫、大有能源、美锦能源涨停。银行板块盘中拉升，中信银行涨超4%。航运板块临近午盘异动，南京港涨停。下跌方面，机器人概念下挫，中大力德、巨轮智能、五洲新春、晋拓股份跌停；半导体板块调整，华虹宏力等跌超10%。个股呈现普跌态势，沪深京三市近5000股飘绿，上午半天成交1.63万亿。午间收盘沪指跌1.96%，深成指跌3.97%，创业板跌4.98%。 2、板块概念方面，煤炭、银行、航运、保险等板块逆势走强；算力硬件、半导体芯片、机器人、创新药等板块领跌； 3、两市共546只个股上涨，31只个
text_en: 1. Markets opened lower and kept falling, with all three major indices sliding. Coal sector rallied against the trend, with Baotailong, Shaanxi Heimao, Dayou Energy, and Meijin Energy hitting limit-up. Banks gained intraday, with China CITIC Bank up over 4%. Shipping moved near midday, with Nanjing Port hitting limit-up. On the downside, robotics concept fell, with Zhongda Leader, Julong Intelligence, Wuzhou Xinchun, and Jintuo shares hitting limit-down; semiconductor sector adjusted, with Hua Hong down over 10%. Stocks broadly declined, with nearly 5,000 stocks in the red across Shanghai-Shenzhen-Beijing; morning turnover was 1.63 trillion yuan. At midday close, Shanghai Composite fell 1.96%, Shenzhen Component 3.97%, ChiNext 4.98%. 2. Sector-wise, coal, banking, shipping, and insurance strengthened against the trend; computing hardware, semiconductor chips, robotics, and innovative drugs led declines. 3. Across both markets, 546 stocks rose, 31 fell...
